title: Etsy 网站模板与预设包数字下载店：给小商家卖现成建站主题，60-160 美元一单
title_en: Etsy Website Template and Preset Shop: Ready-Made Themes for Small Shops at $60-$160
summary: 在 Etsy 向时尚、美妆、健康类小商家卖 Shopify/Wix/Squarespace 网站模板（60-160 美元）与 Lightroom 预设包（14 美元），数字下载无库存无发货。对标店 2022 年开店，89 个模板、5,815 个订单、累计收入约 29.7 万美元，近 12 个月约 2.08 万美元；销量下滑主因是 2026 年只上 3 个新品。复制者新店冷启动务实目标月入 500-1,500 美元。
summary_en: Sell Shopify, Wix and Squarespace website templates ($60-$160) and Lightroom preset packs ($14) on Etsy to small fashion, beauty and wellness shops as instant downloads; the benchmark shop logged 5,815 orders and about $297K lifetime revenue since 2022.
verdict: 客群与付费理由都具体、收入有挂牌数据支撑，但对标店连年下滑且店铺账号不可转让，复制者必须从新店冷启动并靠持续上新续命，C 级值得观察、先小批量验证再扩目录。

metrics.cycle_time: 21~35 天做出首批 5~8 个模板上架
metrics.initial_cost: $50~$200（Etsy 上架费 + 域名 + 设计工具订阅）
metrics.startup_cost: $50~$200（Etsy 上架费 + 域名 + 设计工具订阅）
metrics.est_monthly_profit: $500 ~ $1,500 / 月（复制者稳态，新店冷启动口径；对标店近 12 个月约 $20,800 为成熟店流水，不作承诺）
metrics.revenue_model: 一次性买断：网站模板 $60~$160/个、Lightroom 预设包 $14/个，Etsy 数字下载自动交付

monetization_model: 一次性买断：网站模板 $60~$160/个、Lightroom 预设包 $14/个，Etsy 数字下载自动交付

core_thesis.market_pain: 时尚、美妆、健康类小商家想上线自己的网店，却卡在设计与技术门槛：请设计师做站要数百到数千美元，ThemeForest 等大市场模板偏通用、改起来费劲，自己用 Shopify 默认主题又显得廉价。卖家要的不是代码，而是一个看起来像同行头部店铺、装上就能改图改字上架卖货的现成主题，附带安装说明。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 按垂直品类做模板而不是做万能主题：一个品类一个视觉语言（如美妆护肤、婚礼策划、瑜伽工作室），在 Etsy 用品类长尾词吃搜索流量，60-160 美元的客单价远高于普通数字下载，靠目录量与长尾词滚雪球。边际成本为零、交付全自动、日常维护每天几分钟；再把同一品类的 Lightroom 预设包与社媒模板做成低价加购，提高单均。对标店的教训同样值钱：2026 年只上 3 个新品后收入从 2022 年的 6.26 万英镑跌到 2026 年前十个月的 1.24 万英镑，持续上新是这门生意的命门。与库内 etsy-notion-template-digital-downloads 的差异：本案卖的是给小商家建站的网站主题与摄影预设，客群是开网店的商家，交付物是可安装的主题包与安装指南，不是 Notion 生产力系统。

workflow_steps.title: 锁定一个商家品类与长尾词
workflow_steps.detail: 选一个视觉风格强、商家数量多的小品类（如美妆护肤、婚礼、瑜伽），在 Etsy 搜该品类网站模板，看头部店铺的定价、评价里买家夸什么骂什么、哪些长尾词有搜索没好货。先定 5 个模板选题再动手。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 单品类 5 个模板选题 + 长尾词清单

workflow_steps.title: 做出首批模板与安装包
workflow_steps.detail: 用 Figma 出视觉稿，Shopify 主题按 Online Store 2.0 规范（Liquid/HTML/CSS/JS）落地，Wix/Squarespace 做可复制模板；每个模板配安装指南、预览图与演示视频。首批 5~8 个就上架，不等攒满目录。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 5~8 个可安装模板 + 安装指南 + 预览素材

workflow_steps.title: Etsy 上架与定价
workflow_steps.detail: 网站模板定价 60~160 美元、预设包 14 美元做加购；标题与 13 个标签按品类长尾词写满，数字下载自动交付。用随附的上架检查脚本先验标题、标签与到手价再发布。
workflow_steps.deliverable: Etsy 店铺上架完成、自动交付跑通

workflow_steps.title: 持续上新与多渠道分发
workflow_steps.detail: 每月至少上 2~3 个新模板或变体，这是对标店下滑的直接教训；同步把目录挂到自有网站、Pinterest 与 Creative Market 等模板市场，评价攒起来后搜索排名才稳。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 月度上新节奏 + 至少两个分发渠道

pitfalls_to_avoid: Etsy 店铺账号、评价与搜索排名不可转让，新店冷启动前几个月收入可能接近零，先小批量验证再扩目录；模板必须跟随 Shopify 等平台规范更新，老主题会被下架或差评；只用自有或可商用素材，图片与字体侵权是数字下载店最常见的封店原因；对标店收入连年下滑是真实信号，别拿累计 29.7 万美元当复制者的预期，务实目标按新店口径 500~1,500 美元/月。

en.title: Etsy Website Template and Preset Shop: Ready-Made Themes for Small Shops at $60-$160
en.summary: Sell Shopify, Wix and Squarespace website templates ($60-$160) and Lightroom preset packs ($14) on Etsy to small fashion, beauty and wellness shops as instant downloads with no inventory or shipping. The benchmark shop opened in 2022, sold 5,815 orders across 89 templates for about $297K lifetime revenue, and made about $20,800 in the last 12 months after adding only 3 new listings in 2026.
en.verdict: A specific buyer with a clear reason to pay and listing-backed revenue, but the benchmark shop is in decline and an Etsy shop account cannot be transferred, so copycats start cold and must keep shipping new templates. C tier: validate small first.

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $500 - $1,500 / mo (copycat steady state from a fresh shop; the benchmark $20,800 trailing year is a mature shop, not a promise)
metrics.revenue_model: One-time sales: website templates $60-$160 each, Lightroom preset packs $14 each, delivered as Etsy instant downloads

en.monetization_model: One-time sales: website templates $60-$160 each, Lightroom preset packs $14 each, delivered as Etsy instant downloads

deep_dive.opportunity: Small fashion, beauty and wellness sellers want their own online shop but stall on design and technical skills: a freelance designer costs hundreds to thousands of dollars, big theme marketplaces feel generic, and default themes look cheap. They pay for a ready-made theme that already looks like a leading shop in their niche, with a setup guide, so they can swap photos and text and start selling. Building per-niche templates and winning Etsy long-tail search terms keeps the ticket at $60-$160 with zero marginal cost, while preset packs add a $14 attach item. The benchmark also shows the failure mode: revenue fell from GBP 62,615 in 2022 to GBP 12,395 in the first ten months of 2026 after only 3 new listings that year, so steady new releases are the lifeline.
workflow: Phase 01: Pick one visual niche such as beauty, weddings or yoga, study top Etsy template shops, their prices and review complaints, and list 5 template ideas with long-tail keywords before building.

Phase 02: Design in Figma and build Shopify themes to Online Store 2.0 standards in Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with Wix and Squarespace variants, setup guides, preview images and demo videos; ship the first 5-8 templates.

Phase 03: List on Etsy at $60-$160 per website template with $14 preset packs as add-ons, fill titles and all 13 tags with niche long-tail terms, and run the listing checker for title, tags and net payout before publishing.
Phase 04: Release at least 2-3 new templates or variants every month and expand to your own website, Pinterest and template marketplaces such as Creative Market.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: An Etsy shop account, its reviews and search ranking cannot be transferred, so a fresh shop may earn near zero for the first months; validate with a small catalogue first. Themes must track Shopify and platform standards or they get delisted and down-rated. Use only owned or commercially licensed photos and fonts, since infringement is the most common takedown cause for download shops. Treat the benchmark decline as real and plan on $500-$1,500 per month, not the $297K lifetime figure.
